description: Your numbers, printed. SmartVisuals Receipt is the first till-receipt visual in Microsoft Marketplace. It turns a P&L, a sales order, an expense claim or a cost breakdown into a receipt: lines feed out of a printer slot one by one, sections get their subtotals, discount and tax lines follow, and a bold total closes the slip. Every figure is computed from your data and always adds up. One narrow column reads well at phone width and in a Teams tab, where a wide matrix does not. Free: a complete receipt Bind Item and Amount, add a Section for headers and subtotals. No DAX needed for the arithmetic. Up to 10 item lines; longer data prints the largest items of each section and folds the rest into "+ 4 more items" lines. Subtotals and the total always come from all of your data. P&L ready: subtract the cost sections you name, running totals such as Gross profit, and a Section Order so a running total stays right whatever a reader does. Discount from a measure or a percentage. Tax from a measure, or a rate added to the total or included in the prices. Quantity lines (4 @ 186.00) or a quantity column, an icon per line, item count, Lines Per Section. The measure's own format string is respected, dynamic format strings included; negatives as -1,234, (1,234), 1,234- or 1,234 CR. Paper-feed animation that settles to a complete final frame, so PDF and PowerPoint exports and subscriptions…
